label: Add the switch of the default thresholds of warnings
summary: Adds column "default_warn_thresholds" to "GuildModeration" when it does not have it, off for the guilds that are there and on for the ones to come

execute.description: add the column, off for the guilds that are there
execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."GuildModeration" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "default_warn_thresholds" bool NOT NULL DEFAULT false

execute.description: turn it on for the rows made from now on
execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."GuildModeration" ALTER COLUMN "default_warn_thresholds" SET DEFAULT true

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'GuildModeration' AND column_name = 'default_warn_thresholds') AS "result"
